decisions.source_statement: The categorical dimension of a fusion category over an algebraically closed characteristic-zero field is nonzero.
decisions.formal_specialization: The premodular spherical global dimension, defined as the sum of squared quantum dimensions, is nonzero.
decisions.semantic_gap: Only specialization from fusion-category categorical dimension to the stored spherical presentation.

decisions.source_locator: Crane-Kauffman-Yetter Theorem 2.6; Shum, Tortile Tensor Categories, main framed-tangle coherence theorem
decisions.source_statement: The free tortile category on one object is monoidally equivalent to the category of framed tangles.
decisions.formal_specialization: Positive and negative framed kinks evaluate to the ribbon twist and its inverse.
decisions.semantic_gap: Direct generator-level specialization of framed-tangle coherence; the Shum article locator should still be sharpened if a theorem number is recovered.

decisions.source_statement: For every object X, a basis of Hom(X,Z) and its spherical-trace dual basis resolve the identity of X with weights d(Z).
decisions.formal_specialization: The same identity resolution, quantified over every object and every finite dual basis.
decisions.semantic_gap: Lean makes the finite index type and dual-basis quantifiers explicit.

decisions.source_statement: The mate change used in generalized sliding preserves the spherical dual-basis pairing.
decisions.formal_specialization: The pivotal trace pairing of arbitrary composable morphisms is preserved by the two explicit mate equivalences.
decisions.semantic_gap: The graphical mate convention is expressed by named Lean linear equivalences and must be checked against equation (3.1.10).
